info.title: GTIN Barcode Validation and Lookup API
info.description: Validates GTIN/UPC/EAN barcodes and resolves the GS1 prefix and product metadata when available. Pre-launch design; endpoints are not live yet.

x-planned-pricing.model: free tier for evaluation, paid tiers by volume

servers.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet and answer 503.

get.summary: Validate and look up a barcode
get.description: Validates a GTIN/UPC/EAN barcode and returns check-digit validity, the GS1 prefix and any available product metadata.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: The GTIN, UPC or EAN barcode to validate and look up.

400.description: Barcode is malformed or has an invalid check digit.

503.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Planned for launch: an API key issued on request. Free tier for evaluation, paid tiers by volume; nothing is charged before launch.
